title: De 5 i fedtefadet
writer: Enid Blyton, Günter Ebert, Katrine Hedman
actors: Lone Thielke, Mads Rahbek, Niels Kibenich
plot: 2 boys and 2 girls pack tent etc. on their bikes and go camping at the beach. They bring a German Shepherd. A boy joins them next morning and the "wrong" boy gets kidnapped.
